crossRefs.note: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman…

translations.web: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,
translations.bsb: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,
translations.kjv: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
translations.asv: And now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor;
